//: Agents the swarm can start. By default it uses the agent that launched it (nearest ancestor process in detect.process, else an env var in detect.env), falling back to the first entry; --agent a,b overrides and deals tasks out round-robin. cmd is argv (no shell). files are written into each agent's working directory before it starts. Placeholders: {prompt} {name} {model} {mcp_url} {auth}. With no --cheap or --model the agent runs on its CLI's own default model; otherwise the "{modelArgs}" element of cmd becomes modelArgs when a model is chosen and disappears otherwise. cheap is the model --cheap picks, for test and demo runs.
